entries.failure: A refactoring agent renamed a markup class but left the old rule in the component's scoped <style> block; the compiler pruned the dead selector into a `/* (unused) */` comment with no diagnostic, so the stale style shipped silently.
entries.notes: Triaged to diagnostic:octane-css-unused-selector — the check now ships; the eval task octane.repair-stale-selectors also covers this failure.

entries.failure: An agent wrote the `border` shorthand in a theme applied over a base theme that set `border-top-color`; the merged classes put the shorthand after the longhand in the emitted sheet order, silently clobbering the longhand at runtime.
entries.notes: Triaged to diagnostic:octane-css-shorthand-longhand-clash — the check now ships; the eval task octane.repair-shorthand-clash also covers this failure.
